Quick notes from an initial pass: the regression seems to correlate with our new dynamic batching heuristic that landed last Tuesday; small-batch (<4) requests are waiting longer than before during load bursts. I think there are two possible quick mitigations: 1) tighten the max waiting window for batching on the hosted tier for <64 token paths; 2) enable immediate fast-path for the quantized kernels for small sequences (slightly higher cost but lower tail).

I'll gather traces by host and model variant and post a short note with proposed config to test. Dev — can you pull the kernel logs for the affected nodes (region-us-east-1-prod-pool-3) and the batching traces for 2026-04-26 through 2026-04-28?
